title: How a wisdom tooth is usually taken out
lead: Usually this is one short procedure, then a week or so of healing.

steps.label: Before
steps.words: An X-ray shows how the tooth sits. This is an example position; yours may differ.

steps.label: Take it out
steps.words: With the area numbed, the tooth is lifted out. Sometimes it is taken out in pieces.

steps.label: The first day
steps.words: A blood clot forms in the space. Rest, and do not rinse hard or use a straw.

steps.label: After a week
steps.words: The gum starts to close over the space and the clot is replaced by new tissue.

steps.label: Healed
steps.words: The bone and gum fill in and the area settles.
